origin: Colombia IFN / IDEAM (SiB Colombia DwC-A ideam_ifn v2.1)
allometry: Chave et al. 2005 moist-forest, diameter-only (no height/E available)
wood_density: Global Wood Density DB (Zanne 2009) via BIOMASS; SouthAmericaTrop; species->genus->family->region fallback
dbh_source: back-calculated from per-stem basal area = sqrt(4*(BA/count)/pi)
coord_tier: B (generalized to ~10.6 km grid; exact coords only on request to IDEAM)
CAVEAT: TIER-B coordinates (~10.6 km) -> distributional reference only, NOT 10 m pixel validation. 'datos sin validar'. DBH back-calculated from basal area; multi-stem records use mean DBH. Nested F(154 m2)/FG(707 m2) strata area-weighted.
